Magik.Outfit.description: Pick a whole outfit on a neutral mannequin, then swap any piece. Outputs the outfit as a text description.

state.name: state
state.tooltip: Selection state, written by the outfit picker. Not meant to be edited by hand.

format.name: format
format.tooltip: tags: booru-style tags. natural: plain phrases. both: phrases, then a new line with the tags.

separator.name: separator
separator.tooltip: Joins the pieces. \n and \t are converted to a new line / tab.

prefix.name: prefix
prefix.tooltip: Optional text placed before the outfit, e.g. 'wearing'.

random_source.name: random_source
random_source.tooltip: What random draws come from: catalog outfits, the bundled danbooru attire tag pools (data/attire.json), or either.

randomize.name: randomize
randomize.tooltip: At queue time, draw a random selection (from random_source) instead of using the picker state. The draw is written back to the node and recorded in the PNG metadata.

seed.name: seed
seed.tooltip: Seed for randomize: -1 draws fresh every run; a fixed seed is reproducible.
